text:
maya (Design): dropping a quick Figma for the RBAC / Org settings refresh — roles matrix, invite flow, SSO toggle placement, and audit log nav. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood-rbac-v2 

jon (PM): nice! main goal is to reduce clicks for admins and make it obvious which roles can manage billing/keys. can we show capability badges in the matrix? :eyes:

alex_r (Frontend): i mocked a compact matrix: role rows, resource cols, and an inline dropdown per cell for grant/deny/view. keeps height down. Sketch: `| Role | Billing | Keys | Projects |` then small toggles.

sam_t (Security): question: how enforced for API keys vs UI? if someone is allowed to view keys in UI, do they get key metadata via API? we should be explicit in copy and tooltip. also SSO toggle needs to show downstream effects (automated provisioning off/on).

maya (Design): good call. i'm adding small help text under SSO toggle: "When enabled, SSO controls user login and provisioning; existing invites expire if SSO-only is enforced." copy draft — thoughts?

nina (EngOps): audit log nav needs fast filtering: actor, org, resource, action, and a date histogram. if we load everything at once the console lags. add cursor pagination and a clear export CSV action.

alex_r (Frontend): accessibility nits: keyboard focus order on the matrix must be row-first, aria-describedby for capability badges, and color contrast for the role chips. also ensure the invite modal is reachable via ESC to close.

maya (Design): updated the mock to show role chips with labels + icons, badges for critical perms (billing, keys) and a collapsed "advanced permissions" row. SSO toggle moved above invites to signal precedence. link: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood-rbac-v2?node-id=234%3A12

jon (PM): invite flow: default role should be the caller's org default, but have a one-click "Restrict to view-only" quick option. also need a clearer CTA: "Send invite" vs "Save & Invite" confusion. propose: primary CTA = "Send invite".

sam_t (Security): also add an inline note on invite modal: `Note: Invites accepted via SSO will inherit SSO group mappings; API-key creation requires the "Key Manager" role.` small and grey under the selector.

maya (Design): adding that copy. for the roles matrix we could also offer a CSV import/export for enterprise admins who want to bulk-upsert roles. i'll wireframe the import flow.

nina (EngOps): backend reminder: need role ID + permission bitset in the export, plus idempotency keys for import. i'll send an example payload:
```
POST /orgs/:org_id/roles/import
{
  "roles": [ {"id":"role_abc","name":"Key Manager","bits":"0x1f"} ],
  "client_request_id": "uuid-v4"
}
```

alex_r (Frontend): small UX nit on audit log: when you click an entry, open a side panel not a new page so they can jump between entries. and add keyboard shortcuts: `j/k` to jump entries.

maya (Design): accessibility checklist added to the mock notes: keyboard nav, screen reader labels for matrix cells, focus ring styles, and test plan for VoiceOver/JAWS.

jon (PM): rollout plan: feature-flag behind `rbac_v2_ui`. start alpha for internal + 2 customers, then gradual toggle. add a telemetry event when admin changes a role mapping.

sam_t (Security): ensure audit log records the toggle flips and invite acceptance events with actor and source IP. also SSO toggle flips should be gated by org-admin role only.

maya (Design): thanks — i pushed a tiny iteration with the copy tweaks and the SSO help tooltip. can folks react with :thumbsup: if we should move to dev tickets?

design-bot: created task REDWOOD-UI-331: "RBAC V2 - roles matrix + invite flow" and linked to Figma.

jon (PM): :thumbsup: moving to tickets. nina, can you stub the API shape?

nina (EngOps): on it, will post a proto spec in #eng-platform by EOD.

alex_r (Frontend): quick follow-up — do we want role previews for mobile? matrix might collapse to a list with accordion rows. flagging for responsive design.

maya (Design): noted. i'll add a responsive frame in Figma and a short accessibility testing checklist. thanks everyone! :party:
